notes: This contract records the portable C++ TCK check for callback enable and disable around ordinary object-instance name reservation. The source uses only the standard C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador APIs plus the standard library; the adapter supplies the provider package, FOM, endpoint, and callback configuration. It verifies reservation callback suppression, callback release after re-enable, callback-model servicing, name reuse cleanup, and federation lifecycle without asserting provider-specific names, registries, headers, or implementation behavior.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador callback enable/disable and callback-servicing controls with ordinary reserveObjectInstanceName and FederateAmbassador objectInstanceNameReservationSucceeded delivery
